investment_theses.thesis: Real yields (Treasury yield minus inflation expectations) are compressing equities; rotate from growth/AI stocks into commodities and short-duration bonds through mid-2026.
supporting_signals: 10-year Treasury at 19-year high, driven by sticky inflation and AI capex bond issuance
White House blocking $810M in appropriated funds suggests fiscal tightening headwinds
CNBC headline: sticky inflation + heavy bond supply = structural rate pressure
investment_theses.counter_view: AI capex cycle self-reinforces productivity gains and future earnings growth, offsetting real yield compression; NVDA, MSFT multiples can re-rate higher.
investment_theses.expression: Underweight SPY technology sector (short XLK call spreads or reduce NVDA/MSFT weighting); long commodities (GLD, DBC) or short-duration treasuries (SHV or 2–3 year note futures).

investment_theses.thesis: Geopolitical Iran escalation (Trump rejects ceasefire, expects post-midterm bombing) drives near-term oil spike and USD strength; hedge risk assets.
supporting_signals: CNBC/WSJ: Trump explicitly rejects Iran ceasefire, expects renewed U.S. bombing after midterms
Saudi coalition intercepting Iranian projectiles—active Strait of Hormuz risk
Trump-Xi summit yielded 'spectacle over substance,' no Taiwan/trade de-escalation
investment_theses.counter_view: Past Iran escalations priced in quickly; markets have hedged via oil calls; actual conflict risk remains low (diplomatic offramps remain open).
investment_theses.expression: Long oil (CL=F crude futures or USO ETF); long USD index (DXY) via long USD/JPY carry or short EUR/USD; consider VIX call spreads for tail hedges.

investment_theses.thesis: Crypto prediction market regulation (Kalshi legal losses, Hester Peirce departure) creates temporary uncertainty but long-term clearing event; prediction market tokens will see vol expansion.

Hester Peirce (crypto advocate) departing October 2—successor unknown, likely less favorable
CoinDesk/Cointelegraph covering regulatory escalation; mainstream awareness low
investment_theses.counter_view: Prediction market cap is tiny relative to crypto; regulatory clarity (even negative) depresses token vol and reduces speculation; winners-take-all concentration.
investment_theses.expression: Trade prediction market token pairs (if available) on Uniswap or centralized exchanges; build synthetic spreads on regulatory outcome assumptions; or hold cash and buy dips on SCOTUS filing.

Broader narrative: compliance (Circle/Binance stablecoin partnerships) + privacy (Zcash, Monero interest) are complementary

investment_theses.thesis: Solana and XRP technical upgrades (150ms settlement, Batch processing) signal L1 competition with Ethereum; ETH/SOL and ETH/XRP ratios compress on relative execution parity.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Solana 150ms settlement reaches second test network; validators ramping adoption
XRP Ledger Batch upgrade delayed but proceeding; XRP trending on CoinGecko
NEAR Protocol also trending; multi-chain finality narrative strengthening
investment_theses.counter_view: Ethereum's ecosystem depth, DeFi liquidity, and validator base remain unmatched; technical parity ≠ network effect parity; ETH bull case intact.
investment_theses.expression: Short ETH/SOL ratio (sell ETH, buy SOL) via spot or perp; long SOL/USDC perps with 2–3x leverage; set stops at recent resistance to limit tail risk.
